name: Encore Technologies Corp.
summary: Encore Technologies Corp. operates as a software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, specializing in the creation of a carbon credit management platform known as CERO. This innovative platform is designed to seamlessly connect with existing data infrastructures, empowering data aggregators, asset proprietors, and carbon footprint assessors to furnish transparent and verifiable information. The data thus collected facilitates the precise, real-time quantification of environmental impact reductions. The company caters to a diverse array of sectors, including real estate, manufacturing, data centers, transportation, marine shipping, and waste management. Incorporated in 2023 and headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Encore Technologies Corp. was formerly recognized as CERO Technologies Inc., undergoing its name transformation in June 2025.
